# Wakeel.org

> Wakeel.org is an AI-powered legal assistant that helps citizens, law students, lawyers, and institutions understand legal information, analyze documents, and research law. Originally built around Pakistan's legal system, it now provides legal guidance for the GCC and 15+ countries worldwide. Ask questions in plain English or Urdu, analyze documents up to 100+ pages, and get source-aware legal guidance. Wakeel provides legal information and research support — it is not a substitute for a licensed advocate and does not provide final legal advice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://wakeel.org/): Overview of Wakeel.org, its AI legal assistant capabilities, and who it serves.
- [About](https://wakeel.org/about): Why Wakeel.org exists, its approach, and what it does and does not replace.
- [Features](https://wakeel.org/features): AI legal chat, document analysis, legal research, drafting support, and professional workflows.
- [Pricing](https://wakeel.org/pricing): Free, Student, Professional, and Organization plans.
- [Legal Sources & Trust Framework](https://wakeel.org/legal-sources): How Wakeel uses sources, source-aware answers, and human verification requirements.
- [Legal Disclaimer](https://wakeel.org/disclaimer): Information-only scope, verification requirements, and lawyer-client boundaries.
- [Contact](https://wakeel.org/contact): Partnership, demo, organization access, and support inquiries.

## Who Wakeel serves

- [Citizens](https://wakeel.org/citizens): Understand legal rights, notices, and documents in simple English and Urdu.
- [Law Students](https://wakeel.org/law-students): Study support, case summaries, and legal research for Pakistani law.
- [Lawyers](https://wakeel.org/lawyers): Research, drafting, document review, and matter organization.
- [Law Firms](https://wakeel.org/law-firms): Shared research and document workflows for teams.
- [Judges](https://wakeel.org/judges): Neutral research aid for statutes, precedents, and document summaries.
- [Policymakers](https://wakeel.org/policymakers): Policy and regulation research support.
- [Legal Institutions](https://wakeel.org/legal-institutions): Education, legal aid, and research workflow support.

## Journal articles — practical legal guides (83 articles)

Full, current list of Wakeel Journal articles at /journal/article/<slug>, grouped by topic. Each article cites primary Pakistani statutes with working links to official sources.

### Legal Help — practical guides and how-tos

- [Arrest Without Warrant in Pakistan: When Is It Legal?](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/arrest-without-warrant-pakistan): The specific grounds under Section 54 CrPC that let police arrest without a warrant, and the constitutional safeguards (Article 10) that apply immediately after arrest.
- [Bail in Pakistan: How to Get Bail in a Criminal Case](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-get-bail-in-pakistan): How bail actually works in Pakistan under Sections 497 and 498 CrPC — bailable vs non-bailable offences, pre-arrest vs post-arrest bail, and the application process.
- [Can Police Check Your Mobile Phone Without Permission?](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/can-police-check-mobile-phone-without-permission-pakistan): The constitutional and statutory principles that govern police access to a phone in Pakistan — Article 14 privacy, CrPC search powers, and self-incrimination.
- [Child Marriage Laws in Pakistan and Punjab](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/child-marriage-laws-pakistan-punjab): How child marriage law differs by province in Pakistan — Sindh, Islamabad, and Punjab's 2026 reform set 18 for both sexes, while KP and Balochistan still apply the older 1929 standard.
- [Common Family Law Rights in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/family-law-rights-pakistan): A grounded guide to khula, talaq, custody, maintenance, and haq mehr under Pakistani family law — with the actual statutes and case law behind each.
- [Cyberbullying and Online Harassment Laws in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/cyberbullying-online-harassment-laws-pakistan): The PECA provisions that cover cyberbullying and online harassment in Pakistan — cyberstalking, dignity, and modesty offences — and the remedies available.
- [Cybercrime in Pakistan: Types, Punishments and Legal Remedies](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/cybercrime-in-pakistan-types-punishments-remedies): The main types of cybercrime in Pakistan under PECA 2016 — unauthorized access, dignity and modesty offences, cyberstalking — with punishments and remedies.
- [Daughters' Inheritance Rights in Pakistan: Islamic and Legal Perspective](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/daughters-inheritance-rights-pakistan): A daughter's inheritance rights in Pakistan — the Islamic legal basis, Section 498-A PPC, and the Punjab Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act 2021 remedy.
- [Divorce in Pakistan: Procedure, Rights and Legal Requirements](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/divorce-in-pakistan-procedure-rights): How divorce actually works in Pakistan — talaq, khula, judicial divorce, and talaq-e-tafweez — the Union Council notice procedure and the Family Court process.
- [Drug Laws in Pakistan: Offences, Penalties and Bail](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/drug-laws-pakistan-offences-penalties): How the Control of Narcotic Substances Act, 1997 structures drug offences in Pakistan — quantity-based punishment, special courts, and how bail is approached.
- [False FIR in Pakistan: Legal Remedies and Consequences](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/false-fir-pakistan-legal-remedies): The legal routes available for a false FIR in Pakistan — quashing under Section 561-A CrPC, and prosecuting false information under Sections 182 and 211 PPC.
- [Finding a Property Dispute Lawyer in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-dispute-lawyer-pakistan): How to vet and hire a property dispute lawyer in Pakistan — bar council verification, real experience checks, fee conversations, and red flags to walk away from.
- [FIR Registration in Pakistan: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/fir-registration-step-by-step-guide-pakistan): A numbered, practical walkthrough of registering an FIR in Pakistan under Section 154 CrPC — from the right station to what happens after registration.
- [Free & Online Legal Advice in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/free-legal-advice-pakistan): How to get free and online legal help in Pakistan — free legal information with Wakeel.org plus government legal aid, helplines, bar associations, and legal aid NGOs.
- [Haq Mehr in Pakistan: Rights Before and After Rukhsati](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/haq-mehr-rights-before-after-rukhsati-pakistan): What haq mehr actually is under Pakistani and Islamic law, the difference between prompt and deferred mehr, and how it's enforced through the Family Court if unpaid.
- [How to Complete FIR Registration in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-complete-fir-registration-pakistan): What a properly completed FIR must actually contain under Section 154 CrPC, and the checklist to confirm before you leave the police station.
- [How to Draft a Legal Contract in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/draft-legal-contract-pakistan): The essential elements of an enforceable contract in Pakistan under the Contract Act 1872 — what to include, when stamping and registration apply, and template risks.
- [How to File a Civil Suit in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/civil-suit-pakistan): A practical walkthrough of filing a civil suit in Pakistan under the CPC 1908 — jurisdiction, drafting the plaint, court fees, and a realistic timeline.
- [How to File a Consumer Complaint in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/consumer-complaint-pakistan): How consumer courts work under Pakistan's provincial Consumer Protection Acts, what evidence to collect, and how to build a complaint that gets a hearing.
- [How to File a Cyber Crime Complaint in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nccia-cyber-crime-complaint-pakistan): How to file a cybercrime complaint in Pakistan under PECA 2016 — evidence to collect, the FIA / NCCIA agency transition, and how to track your case.
- [How to File a Cybercrime Complaint in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-file-cybercrime-complaint-pakistan): A step-by-step guide to filing a cybercrime complaint with the NCCIA in Pakistan — preserving evidence, identifying the right PECA offence, and following up.
- [How to File a Legal Complaint in Pakistan: Step-by-Step Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-file-legal-complaint-pakistan): Where to file a legal complaint in Pakistan depending on what happened — criminal, consumer, cyber, labour, civil, or against a public authority.
- [How to Register a Nikah Nama in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nikah-nama-registration-pakistan): What the nikah nama actually records, who registers it, the columns worth reading carefully (including talaq-e-tafweez), and how to get a certified copy.
- [How to Register an FIR in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-register-fir-pakistan): A plain-language, fact-checked walkthrough of FIR registration under Section 154 CrPC — what officers must legally do, and what to do if they refuse.
- [How to Understand a Legal Document Without a Lawyer](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/understand-legal-document-without-lawyer-pakistan): A step-by-step method for reading contracts and agreements in Pakistan on your own — what to look for, red flags to catch, and when to still call a lawyer.
- [How to Verify Property Before Buying in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-to-verify-property-before-buying-pakistan): A practical due-diligence checklist for verifying property in Pakistan before you pay — the fard, encumbrances, seller identity, development authority approval, and benami risk.
- [Human Rights in Pakistan: Constitutional Rights and Remedies](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/human-rights-pakistan-constitutional-remedies): How human rights are protected in Pakistan — the Fundamental Rights chapter, writ jurisdiction, Article 184(3), and the National Commission for Human Rights.
- [Inheritance and Property Rights in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/inheritance-and-property-rights-pakistan): How inheritance works in Pakistan — the governing law for Muslims and non-Muslims, who typically inherits, and the inheritance mutation process.
- [Inheritance Rights of Women and Daughters in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/inheritance-rights-women-daughters-pakistan): The inheritance rights of wives, mothers, daughters, and sisters in Pakistan under Islamic law, and the legal remedies when those rights are denied.
- [Kidnapping, Extortion and Sexual Assault Laws in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/kidnapping-extortion-sexual-assault-laws-pakistan): What the Pakistan Penal Code says about kidnapping, extortion, and assault on modesty — the relevant sections, punishment, and how they're procedurally treated.
- [Marriage Laws in Pakistan: Complete Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/marriage-laws-pakistan-complete-guide): How marriage law actually works in Pakistan — the essentials of a valid nikah, mandatory registration, the nikah nama, provincial minimum age rules, and second marriage requirements.
- [Minority Rights in Pakistan: Constitutional and Legal Protections](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/minority-rights-pakistan-constitutional-legal-protections): The constitutional protections for religious minorities in Pakistan — Articles 20, 22, and 36 — and the National Commission for Minorities Act 2023.
- [NADRA Biometric Verification Issues in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nadra-biometric-verification-pakistan): Why NADRA biometric verification fails, how it affects SIM cards and bank accounts in Pakistan, and the practical steps to actually resolve it.
- [Nikah Nama in Pakistan: Rights, Clauses and Legal Requirements](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/nikah-nama-rights-clauses-pakistan): What each key clause of the nikah nama actually means legally — haq mehr, talaq-e-tafweez (column 18), conditions, and prior-marriage disclosure.
- [PECA Act Pakistan: Complete Guide to Cybercrime Laws](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/peca-act-pakistan-complete-guide-cybercrime-laws): How the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act 2016 works — unauthorized access, offences against dignity and modesty, cyberstalking, and the 2025 amendment.
- [Privacy and Recording Someone Without Consent in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/privacy-recording-without-consent-pakistan): The legal framework around recording and sharing someone without consent in Pakistan — Article 14 privacy, PECA Section 21, and lawful interception.
- [Property Laws for Overseas Pakistanis](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-laws-overseas-pakistanis-pakistan): How overseas Pakistanis can buy, verify, and defend property in Pakistan — power of attorney, NICOP requirements, benami risk, and the new special courts.
- [Property Laws in Pakistan: Complete Guide to Buying, Selling and Ownership](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-laws-pakistan-complete-guide): The core legal framework behind property in Pakistan — the Transfer of Property Act, Registration Act, Stamp Act, and land revenue system — and how buying, selling, and ownership actually work.
- [Property Ownership and Transfer Laws in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-ownership-transfer-laws-pakistan): The types of property ownership in Pakistan — freehold, leasehold, co-ownership — and the legal instruments used to transfer it: sale, gift, will, and court decree.
- [Property Transfer and Mutation Process in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/property-transfer-mutation-pakistan): How property transfer and mutation actually work in Pakistan — sale deed registration, stamp duty, the Patwar Khana process, and what to verify before you buy.
- [Punjab Property Protection Law: Complete Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/punjab-property-protection-law-pakistan): What the Punjab Protection of Ownership of Immovable Property Act 2025 (and its 2026 amendment) actually does — targeting illegal occupation and land grabbing in Punjab.
- [Second Marriage in Pakistan: Is Wife's Permission Required?](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/second-marriage-pakistan-wife-permission): What Section 6 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 actually requires before a second marriage — the Arbitration Council process and the consequences of skipping it.
- [Section 302 PPC: Murder Law and Punishment in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/section-302-ppc-murder-law-pakistan): What Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code covers — qatl-i-amd, the Qisas and Diyat framework, and how punishment and procedure actually work in a murder case.
- [Section 377 PPC: Law Explained in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/section-377-ppc-explained-pakistan): What Section 377 of the Pakistan Penal Code actually states, its origin, and how it fits into Pakistan's criminal procedure — a factual, statute-focused explainer.
- [Section 420 PPC: Fraud and Cheating in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/section-420-ppc-fraud-pakistan): What Section 420 of the Pakistan Penal Code actually covers, the ingredients that must be proven, and how it differs from a civil money dispute.
- [Sections 375 & 376 PPC: Rape Laws and Punishment in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/sections-375-376-ppc-rape-law-pakistan): What Sections 375 and 376 PPC cover, and how the Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act 2021 changed investigation and trial timelines for these cases.
- [Sections 392–402 PPC: Robbery, Theft and Dacoity Laws](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/robbery-theft-dacoity-laws-pakistan): What Sections 379 through 402 of the Pakistan Penal Code cover — the legal difference between theft, robbery, and dacoity, and how punishment escalates with each.
- [Social Media Laws in Pakistan: What You Can and Cannot Post](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/social-media-laws-pakistan-what-you-can-post): What Pakistani law actually restricts on social media — defamation, non-consensual content, cyberstalking, and the debated new Section 26-A offence.
- [Talaq in Pakistan: Legal Procedure and Requirements](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/talaq-in-pakistan-legal-procedure): The exact statutory procedure for talaq in Pakistan under Section 7 of the Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 — Union Council notice and the 90-day period.
- [Tenant Rights Under Pakistan's Rent Laws](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/tenant-rights-rent-law-pakistan): What tenants are entitled to under provincial rent laws — written agreements, protection from arbitrary eviction, rent increase rules, and dispute resolution.
- [The Exit Control List (ECL) in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/exit-control-list-ecl-pakistan): What the Exit Control List is under the Exit from Pakistan (Control) Ordinance 1981, who can place a name on it, and the removal process.
- [Understanding Legal Notices in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/understanding-legal-notices-pakistan): What a legal notice actually means, why lawyers send them, what your deadline really requires, and how to respond without panicking.
- [What You Must Know About FIR Registration in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/what-you-must-know-fir-registration-pakistan): Common misconceptions about FIR registration in Pakistan, corrected — plus the rights every citizen actually has under Section 154 CrPC.
- [Women's Legal Rights in Pakistan: Complete Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/womens-legal-rights-pakistan-complete-guide): A foundational guide to women's legal rights in Pakistan — constitutional equality, marriage and inheritance protections, anti-violence laws, and workplace harassment remedies.
- [Women's Rights in Wani and Swara Cases](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/womens-rights-wani-swara-cases-pakistan): What Vani and Swara are, why they're criminal offences under Section 310-A PPC, and what a woman's legal options are if she's being compelled into one.
- [Wrongful Termination in Pakistan: Know Your Rights](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/wrongful-termination-pakistan): What counts as wrongful termination under the Standing Orders Ordinance 1968 and Industrial Relations Act 2012 — notice, misconduct inquiries, retrenchment rules, and how to challenge an unlawful dismissal.

### Law Study & Research

- [Civil Law in Pakistan: Complete Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/civil-law-in-pakistan-guide): How civil law works in Pakistan — the key statutes, the stages of a civil suit under the CPC 1908, and how civil law differs from criminal law.
- [Common Legal Sections (Dafaat) in Pakistan Explained](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/common-legal-sections-dafaat-pakistan): Plain-language explanations of the PPC and CrPC sections cited most often in Pakistan — murder, theft, fraud, FIR registration, bail, and more.
- [Constitution of Pakistan 1973: Complete Guide to Fundamental Rights](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/constitution-of-pakistan-1973-fundamental-rights): What Articles 8 to 28 of Pakistan's 1973 Constitution actually protect, what the 18th Amendment added, and how fundamental rights get enforced.
- [Criminal Law in Pakistan: Complete Guide](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/criminal-law-in-pakistan-guide): How criminal law works in Pakistan — the Pakistan Penal Code, the CrPC's investigation and trial process, and where special laws take over.
- [How Courts Work in Pakistan: Complete Guide to Court Procedures](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/how-courts-work-in-pakistan): Pakistan's court hierarchy explained — the Supreme Court, High Courts, Federal Shariat Court, district judiciary, and special tribunals.
- [Pakistan Law: Complete Guide to the Legal System](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/pakistan-legal-system-guide): How Pakistan's legal system actually works — the Constitution, common law method, the federal-provincial split, and how civil and criminal law fit together.
- [Pakistani Law vs Common Law: What's Actually Different](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/pakistani-law-vs-common-law): Is Pakistan a common law country? How it inherited common law method, and where codification, the Constitution, and Islamic law review make it a hybrid system.
- [Wakeel AI for Law Students in Pakistan](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/wakeel-ai-for-law-students-pakistan): How LLB students use Wakeel.org for statute explanations, case law research, bilingual study notes, and LGAT prep — and the honest limits of AI for coursework.
- [Writ Jurisdiction of High Courts in Pakistan Explained](https://wakeel.org/journal/article/writ-jurisdiction-high-courts-pakistan): What Article 199 of Pakistan's Constitution covers — the five writs, when they apply, and how they differ from the Supreme Court's Article 184(3) jurisdiction.
